Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Exact PvP cues, Smart Tab, reliable held helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with exact native-nameplate cues, LB notifications, pressure and CC awareness, a bounded Purify-first held scheduler, Smart Tab, Emergency Teleport, assist macros, local MP sounds, job tools, and target highlights.
Changelog: Hotbar Turbo now travels through XIV's native hotbar scan so the bar and Seiton's Latest Input can observe the press; an unconsumed scan is diagnostic-only and never triggers a hidden direct fallback. Viper Serpent's Tail now uses the exact hostile current target in Wolves' Den duels, with the reviewed dummy path retained. Ninja Shukuchi Hidden blocks automatic Purify and Recuperate at scheduler and final native boundaries. The nonfunctional Scholar dot/shield/Deployment Tactics automation was removed while Scholar Critical Strategy remains. Compact buffer/Turbo counters were added without live file scanning or per-frame log spam. Configuration schema 40 remains current; all 510 Core tests pass; current-patch in-game validation remains separate.
